issues.explanation: In 研いだ, this is the past auxiliary た with the voiced surface form だ, not the copula lemma だ.
issues.suggested_fix: Set lemma to た; retain kana だ and meaning past.

issues.explanation: Here 怒り is the continuative form of 怒る meaning “to become angry,” conventionally read おこり in this context; いかり is the noun reading or a different verb reading.
In 産んだ, this is the past auxiliary た with the voiced surface form だ, not the copula lemma だ.
issues.suggested_fix: Set lemma to た; retain kana だ and meaning past.

issues.explanation: 不人情 here describes someone as inhuman or heartless; “inhumanity” is an abstract noun and does not fit the attributive construction 不人情なもの.
猫族 refers to the cat race, species, or cat-kind, not simply “cat kind,” which is unnatural and underspecified in English.
